title: KERNOVA Welcome
start_intro: Connect with the network controls in the system tray or open Network Settings below.
live_intro: Try Plasma and the included applications in this live session. Save important files to separate storage before restarting. To install, restart with the KERNOVA media connected and choose Install or Graphical install in the boot menu. Review the target disk and partition changes before confirming installation.
installed_intro: Open Discover from Applications and choose Updates to check for Debian updates. Discover will report the result. Keep a backup and consult Help for recovery steps and local KERNOVA package updates.
unknown_intro: The boot parameters could not be read. Use Network Settings to connect, or see Help for update and recovery instructions.
personalize_text: Use System Settings to choose a light or dark theme, adjust display scaling, or reduce animation in the General Behavior settings. To change the wallpaper, use Configure Desktop and Wallpaper from the desktop menu.
apps_text: Open an everyday application or use Discover to find software and review updates.
help_text: The local guide covers Debian and KERNOVA updates, logs, backups, and recovery. If a kernel update causes trouble, restart and look for a previous installed kernel in the bootloader’s advanced options. Use live media and a separate backup to recover your files when needed.
guide_missing: The local user guide is missing from the KERNOVA Welcome installation.
guide_unreadable: The local user guide could not be read. Check the KERNOVA Welcome package installation.
credits_text: KERNOVA OS combines the Debian operating system, the KDE Plasma desktop, and KERNOVA applications and artwork. The desktop and everyday applications build on work by the Debian, KDE, Linux, Qt, and other open-source communities.
licenses: Installed packages record license and copyright information in /usr/share/doc. KERNOVA Welcome uses Python and Qt for Python (PySide6).
autostart_hint: Controls automatic launch for this account. Welcome is always available in the application menu.
save_failed: The sign-in preference could not be saved. Check the permissions and free space in your home directory.
launch_failed: {app} could not start. Check that the related package is installed.
ordinary_user: Open KERNOVA Welcome from a regular desktop account.
